tools.name: ti_sources
tools.description: List every configured public Threat Intel source ID, name, format, surface and source URL from the pinned collector registry. Free; no user data, repositories, or credits. No arguments. Use the exact ID in ti_latest.source; guessed aliases are rejected. The complete bounded catalog is returned in on

tools.name: ti_classes
tools.description: List every supported Threat Intel class ID and the taxonomy version. Free; no user data, repositories, or credits. No arguments. Use the exact ID in ti_latest.class; unknown IDs are rejected. The complete bounded catalog is returned in one response. Classes can overlap; unknown means no supported as

tools.name: ti_latest
tools.description: Read new or changed threats from Midkernel's public-source Threat Intel. Free; no repositories, user data, or credits. Pass since as an ISO timestamp (inclusive); until is an exclusive upper bound, defaults to now, and must be at most 60 days later. timeField=changedAt includes new evidence and sema

tools.name: ti_trends
tools.description: Free analytics over Midkernel's own public-source Threat Intel. window.from/to are inclusive UTC source-effective dates, at most 60 days. Compare canonical threat counts with the immediately preceding equal-length window, grouped by class, source, or day. These measure collected evidence, not attack

tools.name: ti_get
tools.description: Read one Midkernel Threat Intel record, retained evidence and revisions, plus known-exploited (KEV) evidence joined via CVE. Use a record id from ti_latest, a CVE, or a GHSA id. Free; no user data or credits. KEV absence in the ingested evidence is not proof a vulnerability is unexploited. Retained

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "threat-intel" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ti_daily_report, ti_sources, ti_get · Private data: ti_sources, ti_latest, ti_get · Public sink: ti_daily_report, ti_sources, ti_classes, ti_latest, ti_trends, ti_get · Destructive: ti_sources, ti_latest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ti_daily_report, ti_sources, ti_get · Private data: ti_sources, ti_latest, ti_get · Public sink: ti_daily_report, ti_sources, ti_classes, ti_latest, ti_trends, ti_get · Destructive: ti_sources, ti_latest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
